description: Promotion state and evidence contract for physical hypotheses with measurable operators. Structural package completeness never counts as empirical admission.

operator_set: specimen and fixture temperature fields in K
packages.advance_rule: Calibrate every operator, fit the conventional constitutive model only on calibration data, commit the blind allocation, close all nine energy channels within three propagated standard uncertainties, pass Holm-corrected tests for the three registered observables, and replicate independently.
blockers: No specimen composition, orientation, geometry, or electrode record
No calibration files or raw blinded cycles
No uncertainty covariance or complete measured energy ledger

operator_set: cooling and readout work in J
system energy change and bath heat in J
net useful period work in J
packages.advance_rule: First admit subharmonic order and lifetime against phase-destroying controls. Open the energy claim separately only after all period-resolved channels close within three propagated standard uncertainties; require a multiplicity-corrected positive lower confidence bound and independent replication.
blockers: No period-resolved work, heat, storage, or loss ledger

locked_controls: general relativity with matched matter and boundaries
minimally coupled scalar with matched energy and spectrum
packages.advance_rule: Freeze a covariant action, derive field equations and stress tensor, reject ghosts and physical instabilities, require normalized constraints <= 1e-8 under refinement, then pass a Holm-corrected held-out distinguishing test and independent reproduction.
blockers: No covariant action, units, gauge, background, or boundary data
No derived equations or perturbation spectrum

operator_set: radiated and dissipated energy in J
packages.advance_rule: Require a physical device and complete return cycle, calibrated measurements for every channel, three-sigma closure, a multiplicity-corrected positive lower confidence bound for net work, and independent replication.
blockers: No physical device or declared complete cycle
No blinded controls or independent replication

excluded_until_redefined.missing_definition: Domain, codomain, operator law, topology, state map, and observable
Intervention, dose, causal model, operational endpoint, comparator, and replication protocol
